findings.why: "Day 0 / Week 2" labels frame a before/after progression, which draws platform restrictions and needs representative, unretouched evidence.
findings.fix: Remove the Day 0 / Week 2 labels, or show only the study qualifier text.

rule_hit_review.why: 97% perception stat is shown with duration (2 weeks) and perception wording in the footnote; no n given, so acceptable only if the study file supports it.

tone_read: Calm, declarative and education-led, in line with Minimalist voice; no fear, hype or urgency pressure.
language_read: Actives and strengths are named as on the product page and the rating carries its source and capture date.
